items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wouldn’t it be great if I could get Yo Yo Ma to play?

ctx.x: Through composed, or maybe some spots for improvisation. There are people who can do that now. Or through composed. Wouldn’t it be great if I could get Yo Yo Ma to play?
Well, that’s the way he’s going to be able to do that. It’s going to have to be written. But he can improvise.
